This leads to subtle, intermittent bugs like lost updates, dirty reads, or data corruption. Race conditions are prevented by enforcing mutual exclusion around critical sections. Primary mechanisms include mutex locks (pthread_mutex), read-write locks, semaphores, and atomic hardware primitives (e.g. compare-and-swap).
